posts.name: FreedomGunfire
posts.cooked:
My first is in Flay, but never in normal. (So we get "F" or "y")

My second's in you (if we're being informal). (So "y", "o" or "u")

My third is in most words - three times in your base. (pretty clearly "e")

Any my last's in the past and a place out of space. (So "L" or "c", based on Meerkat's Gulch/Block connection)

My best guess, then, is "Fuel"

posts.name: darksurtur
posts.cooked:
SOLUTION: FUEL

---

Ah; looking for more? I like it, new foe.
For nothing comes easy, or how would we grow?
My first is in Flay, but never in normal. -> F (check the letters)
My second’s in you (if we’re being informal). -> u (informal)
My third is in most words - three times in your base. e from Freedom Tower
And my last’s in the past and a place out in space. -> l per BlueHairedMeerkat
The timeline is broken; before you go mend it
Take the fruits of your labor and simply append it.

Caesar cipher

In cryptography, a Caesar cipher, also known as Caesar's cipher, the shift cipher, Caesar's code, or Caesar shift, is one of the simplest and most widely known encryption techniques. It is a type of substitution cipher in which each letter in the plaintext is replaced by a letter some fixed number of positions down the alphabet. For example, with a left shift of 3, D would be replaced by A, E would become B, and so on. The method is named after Julius Caesar, who used it in his private corresp
